text.p: Glasgal Communications Inc said on Tuesday that after charging non-recurring acquisition costs of $405,000 for the second quarter ended October 31, 1996 net income was $32,000 compared to $222,000 last year.
Net income for the six months was $1,426,277 after acquisition charges of $497,000 compared to $1,132,278 after $223,000 of extraordinary charges for the same period last year.

Glasgal's sales in the three and six months ended October 31, 1996 were $25.2 million and $52.6 million, respectively, which were a reduction of 21.6 percent and 16.4 percent respectively over the same periods last year.
The company's press release did not provide per share information and a spokesman was not available.
